zh-CN.app.title: 孤独摇滚 · Codex 主题
zh-CN.picker.label: 选择壁纸
zh-CN.picker.failed: 这次没能换好壁纸，原来的画面已经保留。请稍后再试。
zh-CN.wallpaper.color-portraits: 四色肖像 · 夜场切片
zh-CN.wallpaper.backstage: 演出散场 · 后台合影
zh-CN.wallpaper.floating-bocchi: 波奇失重 · 乐器宇宙
zh-CN.wallpaper.winter-night: 冬日候场 · 暖灯店门合照
zh-CN.wallpaper.headphone-evening: 随身节拍 · 四色合拍
zh-CN.shortcut.description: 孤独摇滚 · 六款壁纸与 STARRY 切换
zh-CN.install.source: 这是源码包，还缺少运行环境。请下载 Windows 完整包，解压后再安装。
zh-CN.install.runtime: 运行文件与发行记录不一致。请重新下载并解压完整包，再试一次。
zh-CN.install.assets: 有素材没能通过检查。请重新解压完整包，再试一次。
zh-CN.install.version: 这版主题还没有适配你当前的客户端。原界面会保持不变，请使用匹配的主题包。当前：{0} / {1}；本版需要：{2} / {3}。
zh-CN.install.checked: 版本、运行环境和六款素材都检查好了；没有创建配置或快捷方式。
zh-CN.install.moved: 这个安装目录移动过了。请在新解压的完整包里安装，旧目录可以先留着，方便回退。
zh-CN.install.otherRelease: 这个文件夹属于另一版本。请把新版解压到新文件夹，旧版先保留。
zh-CN.install.done: 安装好了。双击桌面的 Bocchi Codex Theme，或运行 02-启动主题.cmd，就可以开始使用啦。
zh-CN.install.preserved: 官方外观设置保持原样，也没有添加开机启动。
zh-CN.install.checkFailed: 安装检查暂时没能完成，原界面没有改动。下面的诊断信息可以帮助排查：
zh-CN.entry.setupFirst: 请先运行 01-安装.cmd（Install.cmd），完成本机配置后再打开主题。
zh-CN.entry.failed: 这次主题操作没有完成。
zh-CN.entry.help: 可以查看 docs 中的《常见问题》和《恢复与回退》。如果需要反馈，请附上下面的诊断信息，并先去掉个人内容。
zh-CN.manager.parallel: Codex 已经打开了。请先保存草稿并结束正在进行的工作，退出原窗口后再从主题入口打开。这样手机与桌面就能使用同一个会话。
zh-CN.manager.parallelWarning: 主题会继续使用当前窗口。另一个 Codex 窗口也在运行；如果手机提示会话被占用，请确认连接的是当前窗口。
zh-CN.manager.paused: 主题已暂停，当前窗口可以继续使用。需要时运行“恢复主题”就好。
zh-CN.manager.restored: 已恢复普通客户端，原有配置和设置都已保留。
zh-CN.manager.running: 主题已经就绪。点击右上角 STARRY，挑一张喜欢的壁纸吧。
zh-CN.manager.resumed: 主题已恢复，当前画面也已确认加载。
zh-CN.manager.updated: 客户端版本发生了变化，这版主题已停止应用。请下载与当前客户端匹配的主题包。
zh-CN.manager.waiting: 客户端已经打开，但主题还没确认就绪。请先完成登录，进入聊天或工作首页，然后运行“恢复主题”。主题会自动使用深色显示；若仍未成功，可以查看本地诊断状态。
zh-CN.manager.dark: 这次没能自动使用深色显示。可以先把 Codex 外观切换为深色，再运行“恢复主题”，不需要重新安装。
zh-CN.manager.generic: 暂时没能完成这一步。请查看下方诊断信息，或参考常见问题中的对应说明。
zh-CN.language.saved: 语言设置已保存：{0}。运行中的主题会在几秒内更新；暂停中的主题会在恢复时应用。
zh-CN.language.invalid: 请输入 1、2 或 3，或者直接按回车保留当前设置。
zh-CN.assets.checked: 六款壁纸、环境背景和贴纸都检查好了。
zh-CN.manager.parallelBackground: Codex 的窗口已关闭，但后台还没有退出。启动器已等候 20 秒。请在系统托盘中选择 Codex 的 Exit，再直接打开主题入口；如果你已经这样做过，可以保留本次启动记录继续排查，无需重装或删除数据。
zh-CN.manager.parallelVisible: 普通 Codex 窗口仍在运行。请先保存草稿、等正在进行的工作结束，再在系统托盘中选择 Exit，随后直接打开主题入口。启动器已等候 20 秒，没有关闭你的窗口。
zh-CN.manager.parallelUnknown: 暂时无法确认 Codex 是否已完全退出。当前窗口和数据都保留着，可以查看本次启动记录继续排查，无需重装。
zh-CN.manager.operationTimeout: 前一次主题操作还没有完成，这次请求尚未执行。请保留当前窗口，稍后再试；无需重装。
zh-CN.manager.connectionWaiting: 客户端已收到启动请求，但主题连接还没有就绪。请保留当前窗口。本次启动记录已经保存，可以据此继续排查，无需反复打开或重装。
zh-CN.manager.reused: 主题已经加载好了。这次重复启动已复用当前窗口，可以继续使用。

en.app.title: Bocchi the Rock! · Codex Theme
en.picker.label: Choose a wallpaper
en.picker.failed: We couldn’t switch wallpapers this time. Your previous wallpaper is still here. Please try again.
en.shortcut.description: Bocchi the Rock! · Six wallpapers and the STARRY picker
en.install.source: This is the source package. Please download and extract the Windows package, which includes the runtime, then run Install.cmd.
en.install.runtime: The runtime doesn’t match this release. Please download and extract a fresh Windows package, then try again.
en.install.assets: Some artwork couldn’t be verified. Please extract a fresh copy of the Windows package and try again.
en.install.version: This theme release doesn’t support your current client version yet. Your original interface will stay as it is. Please use a matching theme package. Installed: {0} / {1}. Required: {2} / {3}.
en.install.checked: The client version, runtime and all six wallpapers passed the checks. No settings or shortcuts were created.
en.install.moved: This installation folder has moved. Please install from a freshly extracted package. You can keep the old folder for rollback.
en.install.otherRelease: This folder belongs to another release. Please extract the new version into a separate folder and keep the old one for rollback.
en.install.done: You’re all set. Open Bocchi Codex Theme on your desktop, or run Start.cmd, to get started.
en.install.preserved: Your official appearance settings are unchanged, and no startup task was added.
en.install.checkFailed: Setup couldn’t finish its checks. Your original interface is unchanged. These details may help identify the cause:
en.entry.setupFirst: Please run Install.cmd first, then open the theme again.
en.entry.failed: The theme couldn’t finish this step.
en.entry.help: You’ll find help in docs/en/troubleshooting.md and docs/en/upgrade-restore.md. If you report this, include the diagnostic details below after removing any personal information.
en.manager.parallel: Codex is already open. Please save your drafts, let active work finish and exit the ordinary window before opening the theme shortcut. This helps your phone and desktop use the same session.
en.manager.parallelWarning: The theme will keep using this window. Another Codex window is also open; if your phone reports that the session is in use, check that it’s connected to this window.
en.manager.paused: The theme is paused. You can keep using this window and run Resume.cmd whenever you’d like it back.
en.manager.restored: The ordinary client is back. Your original profile and settings have been preserved.
en.manager.running: Your theme is ready. Choose a wallpaper from STARRY in the top-right corner.
en.manager.resumed: The theme is back, and the current view has finished loading.
en.manager.updated: Your client version has changed, so this theme release has stopped applying. Please use a theme package that matches the current client.
en.manager.waiting: The client has opened, but the theme isn’t ready yet. Please finish signing in, open the Chat or Work home page, then run Resume.cmd. Dark appearance is applied automatically. If that doesn’t help, check the local diagnostic status.
en.manager.dark: Automatic dark appearance couldn’t be applied. Please switch Codex to dark appearance and run Resume.cmd. There’s no need to reinstall.
en.manager.generic: We couldn’t finish this step. Please check the diagnostic details below or look up the matching situation in the troubleshooting guide.
en.language.saved: Language saved: {0}. A running theme will update in a few seconds; a paused theme will apply it when resumed.
en.language.invalid: Please enter 1, 2 or 3, or press Enter to keep the current setting.
en.assets.checked: All six wallpapers, environment backgrounds and stickers passed the checks.
en.manager.parallelBackground: The Codex window has closed, but its background process is still running after a 20-second wait. Choose Exit from the Codex tray icon, then open the theme shortcut directly. If you already did this, keep the startup trace for troubleshooting; there is no need to reinstall or delete data.
en.manager.parallelVisible: An ordinary Codex window is still open after a 20-second wait. Save your drafts, let active work finish, choose Exit from the Codex tray icon, then open the theme shortcut directly. Your window has been left open.
en.manager.parallelUnknown: The launcher could not confirm whether Codex has fully exited. Your windows and data are untouched. The startup trace can help investigate; there is no need to reinstall.
en.manager.operationTimeout: The previous theme operation is still running, so this request has not been carried out. Keep the current window and try again later. There is no need to reinstall.
en.manager.connectionWaiting: The client received the startup request, but its theme connection is not ready yet. Keep the current window. A startup trace was saved to help investigate; you do not need to keep opening the shortcut or reinstall.
en.manager.reused: Your theme is already loaded. This repeated launch has reused the current window, so you can keep working.
